AD_CHECK_FAIL.name: AD_CHECK_FAIL
AD_CHECK_FAIL.description: AD (analog to digital converter) self check failure
AD_CHECK_FAIL.impact:
l This alarm may affect services.
l Parameters related to the AD chip on the board, such as board input/output optical
power, back facet current and cooling current, fail to be queried on the U2000. As a
result, maintenance engineers can neither obtain the current operation performance data
of the network nor find in time any potential problems of the network operation. The
alarm may interrupt services in the system or even make the system down. Therefore,
this alarm should be handled immediately.

ALC_ADJUST_FAIL.name: ALC_ADJUST_FAIL
ALC_ADJUST_FAIL.impact:
The line attenuation is excessively large and cannot be compensated by adjusting the intra-NE
attenuation or gain. In this case, the service signals may be unstable and the BER may
increase.

ALC_WAIT_ADJUST.name: ALC_WAIT_ADJUST
ALC_WAIT_ADJUST.description: ALC link anomaly and wait for adjustment
ALC_WAIT_ADJUST.impact:
The line attenuation is excessively large and the signal quality may be affected.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
510

ALS_ACTIVE.name: ALS_ACTIVE
ALS_ACTIVE.impact: When the alarm is generated, the lasers on the related boards are turned off automatically.

ALS_TRIGGERED.name: ALS_TRIGGERED
ALS_TRIGGERED.description: The laser on a board is disabled by ALS
ALS_TRIGGERED.impact: The services that traverse the board reporting this alarm may be interrupted.

ALM_ALS.name: ALM_ALS
possible_causes: The settings of timeslots and other parameters of the VCTRUNKs at both ends are inconsistent.
The performance of the service transmission line degrades.
The board reporting the alarm is faulty.
ALM_ALS.impact: If a board fails to align the GFP frame during data transmission, services will be interrupted.

ALM_GFP_dLFD.name: ALM_GFP_dLFD
ALM_GFP_dLFD.description: The loss of generic framing procedure (GFP) frame delineation

ALM_HANGUP.name: ALM_HANGUP
ALM_HANGUP.description: The orderwire phone is in the off-hook state for a long time
ALM_HANGUP.impact:
l The ALM_HANGUP alarm does not affect the services or communication of the NE.
l The ALM_HANGUP alarm indicates that the orderwire phone of the NE is in the off-
hook state for a long time.

AMBIENT_TEMP_FLUCT.name: AMBIENT_TEMP_FLUCT
AMBIENT_TEMP_FLUCT.impact:
The ambient temperature has large fluctuation, which may cause the board to run abnormally.
As a result, bit errors are generated and services are affected. This alarm should be handled
immediately.

APE_ADJUST_FAIL.name: APE_ADJUST_FAIL
APE_ADJUST_FAIL.impact: The OSNR of receive signals degrades.

APE_ADJUST_PEND.name: APE_ADJUST_PEND
APE_ADJUST_PEND.description: APE adjustment is pending for operation.
APE_ADJUST_PEND.impact: The OSNR of receive signals degrades.

APS_MANUAL_STOP.name: APS_MANUAL_STOP
APS_MANUAL_STOP.description: The MSP protocol is manually stopped
APS_MANUAL_STOP.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the MSP switching protocol does not work, which causes the MSP
failure.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
525

APS_FAIL.name: APS_FAIL
APS_FAIL.impact:
When this alarm occurs, services cannot be switched. In addition, if the existing path cannot
be used, services will be interrupted.

APS_INDI.name: APS_INDI
APS_INDI.description: An alarm indicating the APS state
possible_causes: An external command is issued to initiate a switching (such as manual switching, forced switching, exercise switching, and lockout of switching). OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 522
There is an alarm that triggers an automatic MSP switching, for example, R_LOS, R_LOF, MS_AIS, B2_EXC, or B2_SD.
The service board is faulty.
The SCC board is faulty.
APS_INDI.impact:
l The APS_INDI alarm indicates a fiber cut or a terminal node failure, which triggers
MSP switching.
l For a two-fiber ring MSP or a linear MSP, if a fiber cut or another fault occurs after this
alarm is reported, the services will be interrupted.

ARP_FAIL.name: ARP_FAIL
possible_causes: IP addresses of ports at both ends are not configured with IP addresses, or the ports are not in the same network segment.
Loop is performed for the link.
Port has no traffic.
ARP_FAIL.impact:
When this alarm occurs, services on the interface that reports the alarm are interrupted.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
526

ARP_SPOOF.name: ARP_SPOOF
ARP_SPOOF.impact:
l A lot of CPU resources will be occuiped, causing system instability, and the protocol
jitter.
l Normal ARP protocol packets may be lost, causing the update of the ARP table and then
service packets will be dropped.

ASE_NOT_CALIBRATE.name: ASE_NOT_CALIBRATE
ASE_NOT_CALIBRATE.description: ASE of raman optical module not demarcated
ASE_NOT_CALIBRATE.impact: This alarm affects the ALC adjustment accuracy and therefore may interrupt services.

AU_AIS.name: AU_AIS
possible_causes: The local NE has the higher level alarms.
The upstream NE inserts the AIS alarm to the downstream NE.
The transmit boards on the upstream NE are faulty.
The receive boards on the local NE are faulty.
AU_AIS.impact:
l If no network protection is configured, the services in the VC-4 path that reports the
alarm will be interrupted.
l The AU_AIS alarm is reported on the downstream NEs.

AU_LOP.name: AU_LOP
possible_causes: The number of bit errors received by the local NE exceeds the upper threshold.
The services transmitted by the peer NE and received by local NE are inconsistent in the service level.
Boards on the local NE are faulty.
Boards on the peer NE are faulty.
AU_LOP.impact:
l When this alarm occurs, the services on the VC-4 path will be interrupted if no network
protection is configured.
l After this alarm occurs, the system automatically returns the HP_RDI alarm to the peer
NE by using the G1 byte, and the peer NE reports the HP_RDI alarm.
l This alarm triggers the AU_AIS alarm on the downstream NEs.

B1_EXC.name: B1_EXC
possible_causes: The bit error threshold is not proper.
The ambient environment is abnormal.
Line performance deteriorates.
The equipment is not grounded properly
The local receive board is faulty.
The peer transmit board is faulty.
The clock configuration is incorrect, or the clock unit performance deteriorates
B1_EXC.impact: l When this alarm occurs, the quality of transmitted services has badly deteriorated.

B1_SD.name: B1_SD
B1_SD.impact: When this alarm occurs, the quality of transmitted services has deteriorated.

B2_EXC.name: B2_EXC
B2_EXC.impact:
l When the B2_EXC alarm is generated, the quality of the transmitted services is
degraded.
l When the B2_EXC alarm is reported, the system returns the M1 byte to the opposite end,
indicating the MS_REI alarm. Consequently, the opposite station reports the MS_REI
alarm.

B2_SD.name: B2_SD
B2_SD.impact:
l When the B2_SD alarm is reported, the quality of the transmitted services is degraded.
l When the B2_SD alarm is reported, the system may return the M1 byte to the opposite
end, indicating the MS_REI alarm. Consequently, the remote station may report the
MS_REI alarm.

B3_EXC.name: B3_EXC
B3_EXC.description: The number of higher order path B3 bit errors in the signals received on the line exceeds the threshold
B3_EXC.impact: This alarm will cause bit errors in path-level services.

B3_EXC_VC3.name: B3_EXC_VC3
B3_EXC_VC3.description: The number of B3 bit errors in the lower order path VC-3 exceeds the threshold.
B3_EXC_VC3.impact: This alarm will cause a great number of bit errors in VC-3 services.

B3_EXC_VC4.name: B3_EXC_VC4
B3_EXC_VC4.description: The number of B3 bit errors in the VC-4 path exceeds the threshold.
B3_EXC_VC4.impact: This alarm will cause bit errors in path-level services.

B3_SD.name: B3_SD
B3_SD.description: The higher order path B3 signals received on the line are degraded.
B3_SD.impact: This alarm will cause bit errors in path-level services.

B3_SD_VC3.name: B3_SD_VC3
B3_SD_VC3.description: The number of VC-3 B3 bit errors exceeds the threshold.
B3_SD_VC3.impact: This alarm will deteriorate the service transmission quality of the VC-3 path.

B3_SD_VC4.name: B3_SD_VC4
B3_SD_VC4.description: The number of B3 bit errors in the VC-4 path exceeds the threshold.
B3_SD_VC4.impact: This alarm will cause bit errors in path-level services.

BD_BPXC_MISMATCH.name: BD_BPXC_MISMATCH
BD_BPXC_MISMATCH.description: Board access capacity mismatching backplane cross-connect capacity
BD_BPXC_MISMATCH.impact:
l If this alarm is generated on a universal line board, no packet service can be configured
on the board.
l If this alarm is generated on an OTN line board, no OTN electrical-layer service can be
configured on the board.

BD_NOT_INSTALLED.name: BD_NOT_INSTALLED
BD_NOT_INSTALLED.impact:
When the BD_NOT_INSTALLED alarm occurs, no services can be configured in the
corresponding slot. This alarm, however, does not affect the operation of the system.

BD_SESSION_FAIL.name: BD_SESSION_FAIL
BD_SESSION_FAIL.description: Session broken between NE and remote board
possible_causes: The connection between the NE and remote board is interrupted.
The login account or password is incorrect, causing the login failure.
The SSH public key cannot be adopted. As a result, the NE fails to synchronize the remote board information.
BD_SESSION_FAIL.impact: After the alarm is generated, the NE cannot manage remote boards.

BD_STATUS.name: BD_STATUS
possible_causes: The board is being reset.
The board is not installed or has poor contact with the backplane.
The board is faulty or the backplane has bent pins.
BD_STATUS.impact:
When this alarm occurs, NE configuration data cannot be applied to the board. As a result,
service configuration fails.

BDID_ERROR.name: BDID_ERROR
BDID_ERROR.description: An alarm of slot verification error
BDID_ERROR.impact:
l When this alarm occurs, the board may fail to go online, which will interrupt services.
l When this alarm occurs, services on the board cannot be configured or monitored.

BEFFEC_EXC.name: BEFFEC_EXC
possible_causes: The input optical power of the OTU board is excessively high or low.
The settings of the FEC mode of the interconnected OTU boards are different.
The fiber between the OTU board and the multiplexer/demultiplexer board is faulty.
An inappropriate DCM is installed.
The board that reports this alarm or the board at the opposite station is faulty. The possible causes of this alarm in the case of multiple wavelengths are as follows:
Fibers in the optical cables between stations or the multiplexing portions inside a station are faulty.
The attenuation of the signals during line transmission is excessively high.

The external environment is improper. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 349
BEFFEC_EXC.impact: The error tolerance of the system decreases, which may even affect the quality of signals.

BIOS_STATUS.name: BIOS_STATUS
BIOS_STATUS.impact:
When an abnormality occurs on the board software or hardware, the BIOS_STATUS alarm is
generated and related services are interrupted.

BOOTROM_BAD.name: BOOTROM_BAD
possible_causes: The basic BIOS software of the system control board is damaged. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 354
The extended BIOS software of the system control board is damaged.
The system control board is faulty.
BOOTROM_BAD.impact:
l This alarm does not affect the system or services when the board is operating.
l When this alarm occurs, cold reset or restart will lead to a failure to load the BIOS
software. As a result, the board cannot be started.

BUS_ERR.name: BUS_ERR
possible_causes: The service board does not match the cross-connect board in software version.
The service board is faulty.
The cross-connect board is faulty.
The backplane bus from the service board to the cross-connect board is faulty.
The OTU broad, tributary or line board is not properly inserted or is faulty.
The cross-connect board is not properly inserted or is faulty.
The type of services that are actually received does not match the service type configured on the board.

The pins are faulty or the bus is faulty on the backplane. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 359

When the OTN boards support 100G services or the universal line boards support packet data services, the cross-connect boards (including physical and logical) must be configured for high-capacity boards. If all logic cross-connect boards are configured for high-capacity board in the subrack, while the physical cross-connect board use the ordinary board, this alarm will be reported.
BUS_ERR.impact:
l When the alarm occurs, the services that traverse over the faulty bus are interrupted or
have bit errors.
l When both the active and standby cross-connect boards have the BUS_ERR alarm but
no severer alarm, such as HARD_BAD, no active/standby switching occurs. When only
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms
356
the active cross-connect board has the HARD_BAD alarm, services are switched from
the active board to the standby board.

C2_VCAIS.name: C2_VCAIS
C2_VCAIS.impact: The alarm will cause service interruption.

CFCARD_FAILED.name: CFCARD_FAILED
CFCARD_FAILED.impact:
The CFCARD_FAILED alarm has no impact on the system. The alarm only indicates that the
operations related to the CF card fail.

CFG_DATASA.name: CFG_DATASA
CFG_DATASA.description: VE_FAIL Failure to save configuration data

CFG_DATACHECK_FAIL.name: CFG_DATACHECK_FAIL
CFG_DATACHECK_FAIL.impact: Configuration data will be lost or the database will be damaged.

CFP_LOS.name: CFP_LOS
CFP_LOS.description: Loss of signals in CFP module
possible_causes: No fiber jumper is connected to the optical port on the channel of the CFP module, the fiber jumper connected to the optical port is loose, or the fiber jumper is connected incorrectly.
The line attenuation is excessively high or a fiber cut occurs.
The laser of the board at the opposite station is shut down.
The transmit module of the opposite station or receive module of the local station is faulty.
CFP_LOS.impact: When a fiber cut occurs in the receive direction, services on the channel will be interrupted.

CHAN_ADD.name: CHAN_ADD
CHAN_ADD.description: Channel of single wave signal add
CHAN_ADD.impact:
The MCA cannot monitor the optical spectrum performance of the wavelength related to the
alarm.

CHAN_LOS.name: CHAN_LOS
CHAN_LOS.description: Channel of single wave signal loss
possible_causes: The wavelength that needs to be monitored is not received or the shift of the monitored wavelength exceeds 0.15 nm. For example, in the following figure, λ1 needs to be monitored as configured, but actually λ1 is not received. The possible cause is that the fiber on the WDM side of the OTU1 is not connected. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 361 OTU1 MCA F I U F I U OTU2 OTU3 OTU4 OA M U X/ D M U X OA OA OA M U X/ D M U X Station A Station B Client side WDM side Client side WDM side ?1 ?2 ?1 ?2
The laser on the board at the opposite station is turned off. For example, the laser on OTU1 in the preceding figure is turned off.
The optical power difference between the monitored wavelengths is excessively large. For example, the optical power difference between λ1 and λ2 is excessively large.
The attenuation of the multiplexer or OA board interconnected with the MCA is excessively high.
The OTU board located before the MCA is faulty. For example, OTU1 in the preceding figure is faulty.
The MCA that reports the alarm is faulty.
CHAN_LOS.impact:
l The services of the related wavelength are unavailable.
l The MCA cannot monitor the optical spectrum performance of the wavelength related to
the alarm.

CHIP_ABN.name: CHIP_ABN
CHIP_ABN.impact: When this alarm occurs, the board temperature cannot be correctly detected.

CLIENT_PROT_NOTSTAR.name: CLIENT_PROT_NOTSTAR
CLIENT_PROT_NOTSTAR.description: T Client-side 1+1 protection group not started

CLIENT_PORT_PS.name: CLIENT_PORT_PS
possible_causes: A user delivers an external switching command such as forced switching or manual switching. Such a command makes the active channel of a client 1+1 protection group switch from the working channel to the protection channel, triggering the CLIENT_PORT_PS alarm.
The services on the working channel of a client 1+1 protection group are faulty and the active channel automatically switches to the working channel, triggering the CLIENT_PORT_PS alarm.
CLIENT_PORT_PS.impact:
When a client 1+1 protection group undergoes protection switching, services are transiently
interrupted. When this alarm is generated, the working channel of the client 1+1 protection
group might have services that need to be restored.

CLIENT_PORT_STA_INDI.name: CLIENT_PORT_STA_INDI
CLIENT_PORT_STA_INDI.description: The state of the client-side 1+1 optical channel protection group
possible_causes: A user delivers an external switching command such as forced switching, manual switching, or locked switching.
The services on the working channel or the protection channel of a client 1+1 protection group are faulty.
The switching is in WTR state. After WTR Times (s) elapses, the alarm clears.
CLIENT_PORT_STA_INDI.impact:
l When a client 1+1 protection group undergoes switching, services are transiently
interrupted.
l When this alarm is reported, the working channel or the protection channel of a client
1+1 protection group might have services that need to be restored.

CLK_NO_TRACE_MODE.name: CLK_NO_TRACE_MODE
CLK_NO_TRACE_MODE.description: The clock enters into a non-tracing running mode.
possible_causes: If SDH boards are configured on NEs, a priority table is not manually set for the system, and NEs use their own default priority tables.
A priority table is set, but only the internal clock source in the priority table can be traced.
CLK_NO_TRACE_MODE.impact:
When the CLK_NO_TRACE_MODE alarm is generated, the clock is in the non-tracing
mode. In this case, the system clock is of a low quality. When the low quality clock results in
the out-of-synchronization status among NEs, the clock synchronization performance of the
system is degraded. (For the OCS system, the bit error rate of services increases.)

CLK_LOCK_FAIL.name: CLK_LOCK_FAIL
CLK_LOCK_FAIL.impact:
When this alarm is generated, the NE clock is unlocked. As a result, the time of the slave NE
cannot trace the time of the master NE, and services are prone to bit errors. Hence, handle this
alarm in time once it is reported.

COM_EXTECC_FULL.name: COM_EXTECC_FULL
COM_EXTECC_FULL.description: Number of TCP connections between NEs running the automatically extended ECC protocol exceeding the system limit
COM_EXTECC_FULL.impact: The DCN network will be unstable.

COMMUN_FAIL.name: COMMUN_FAIL
COMMUN_FAIL.description: Internal communication failure on the board
possible_causes: The service board is being reset.
The service board is faulty. Multiple boards may report the COMMUN_FAIL alarm due to the following causes:
The AUX or SEI board is faulty.
The SCC or cross-connect board is faulty.
COMMUN_FAIL.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the NE configurations cannot be applied to a board or the board
cannot work. This may disable service configuration and protection switching and affect new
services.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms
366

CRC4_CROSSTR.name: CRC4_CROSSTR
CRC4_CROSSTR.description: CRC4 multi-frame error code count exceeds the threshold
CRC4_CROSSTR.impact: The alarm has an impact on the services (supervisory channel such as the orderwire signal).

DB_RESTORE_FAIL.name: DB_RESTORE_FAIL
DB_RESTORE_FAIL.impact: The configuration data cannot be saved successfully. As a result, the data is lost.

DBMS_DELETE.name: DBMS_DELETE
DBMS_DELETE.impact:
The NE database will not be automatically backed up to the flash memory of the system
control board until the NE is reset within 48 hours after the NE database is deleted from the
flash memory of the system control board. If the NE is not reset 48 hours later after the NE
database is deleted from the flash memory of the system control board, the NE database are
automatically backed up to the flash memory of the system control board.

DCNSIZE_OVER.name: DCNSIZE_OVER
DCNSIZE_OVER.description: The number of NEs in a DCN subnet exceeds the setting threshold
DCNSIZE_OVER.impact: System resources may be insufficient and therefore services may be affected.

DCNLINK_OVER.name: DCNLINK_OVER
DCNLINK_OVER.description: The number of DCN OSPF neighbors excesses the suggested threshold

DBMS_ERROR.name: DBMS_ERROR
possible_causes: The database operation fails.
Data in the database is damaged.
The board is faulty.
DBMS_ERROR.impact:
Backup of the databases of the active and standby SCC boards fails.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
583
The database cannot be restored automatically.
The system configuration data may be lost. A failure message may be displayed in response to
certain query or setting commands. The functions of the system may be unavailable.

DBMS_PROTECT_MODE.name: DBMS_PROTECT_MODE
DBMS_PROTECT_MODE.impact: In the protection mode, the NE database cannot be backed up.

DBPS_ABNORMAL.name: DBPS_ABNORMAL
DBPS_ABNORMAL.impact:
The following exceptions may result in service disruption.
l If the protocol communication between the active equipment and the standby equipment
in the DBPS protection group cannot be established, there may be two pieces of active
equipment or standby equipment.
l If the DBPS protection status of the active equipment and standby equipment is
inconsistent, the service protection cannot function properly.
l If the snooping protocol used (VRRP or ARP) detects anomalies, the snooping function
cannot be realized, and therefore the protection status of the active equipment and the
protection status of the standby equipment are incorrect.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
586

DCM_INSUFF.name: DCM_INSUFF
DCM_INSUFF.impact:
The alarm does not affect the existing services. The alarm indicates that the system cannot
meet the higher dispersion compensation requirements.

DERIVED_PWR_ERROR.name: DERIVED_PWR_ERROR
DERIVED_PWR_ERROR.impact:
The single optical signal output by the board might be lost. The services have bit errors or
even are interrupted.

DLAG_PROTECT_FAIL.name: DLAG_PROTECT_FAIL
DLAG_PROTECT_FAIL.impact:
When all the DLAG ports fail, or when the board fails to normally communicate with other
boards, the DLAG_PROTECT_FAIL alarm is reported. In the case of the
DLAG_PROTECT_FAIL alarm, services cannot be received or transmitted in the LAG, or
the user cannot check whether services are in the normal state.

DSP_LOAD_FAIL.name: DSP_LOAD_FAIL
DSP_LOAD_FAIL.impact:
Loading the DSP program to the board fails. As a result, the board cannot work normally,
which has an influence on the services of users.

EFI_TYPE_MISMATCH.name: EFI_TYPE_MISMATCH
EFI_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: Mismatch between the EFI board type and subrack type
EFI_TYPE_MISMATCH.impact:
If the system control board of the subrack is reset after this alarm is reported, data in the NE
database will be lost.

ELAN_SMAC_FLAPPIN.name: ELAN_SMAC_FLAPPIN
ELAN_SMAC_FLAPPIN.description: G The source MAC address learned by an E-LAN service undergoes a transfer

ERPS_IN_PROTECTION.name: ERPS_IN_PROTECTION
ERPS_IN_PROTECTION.impact:
If one or more nodes on the ring lose connection when services have been configured,
services may be interrupted.

ETH_APS_LOST.name: ETH_APS_LOST
possible_causes: The opposite NE is not configured with APS protection.
The APS protection group is deactivated.

The physical link is connected incorrectly or is faulty. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 598
ETH_APS_LOST.impact:
Service protection fails.

alarms related to the ETH APS protection group.

ETH_APS_PATH_MISM.name: ETH_APS_PATH_MISM
ETH_APS_PATH_MISM.description: ATCH Mismatch of APS working/ protection paths

ETH_APS_TYPE_MISM.name: ETH_APS_TYPE_MISM
ETH_APS_TYPE_MISM.description: ATCH Mismatch of APS protection type

ETH_8B10B_ERR.name: ETH_8B10B_ERR
possible_causes: The fiber between the access equipment and the optical port on the client side of the board is faulty.
The access equipment is faulty.
The board hardware is faulty.
ETH_8B10B_ERR.impact:
The coding and encoding error of the signals on the Ethernet line may lead to the bit errors. If
not deal with the error in time, the service may be interrupted.

ETH_BIP8_SD.name: ETH_BIP8_SD
ETH_BIP8_SD.impact:
This alarm will trigger bit errors in the services at the optical port, which makes the service
signals invalid or even unusable.
NOTE
If BIP8 thresholds at the local and remote ends are set to different values, the alarms reported at the two
ends will be inconsistent. Therefore, ensure that the BIP8 thresholds are set to the same value at the two
ends.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
604

ETH_HI_BER.name: ETH_HI_BER
ETH_HI_BER.description: 40GE/100GE signal bit errors exceeds the preset threshold
ETH_HI_BER.impact: The alarm has an influence on the QoS of the service signals.

ETH_CFM_LOC.name: ETH_CFM_LOC
possible_causes: The corresponding MEP at the opposite end is not configured correctly.
The configuration of the Ethernet services that correspond to the MAs of the MEPs at both ends is incorrect.
The service transmission line between the MEPs at both ends is interrupted.
The network is congested seriously.

ETH_CFM_MISMERGE.name: ETH_CFM_MISMERGE
possible_causes: The level of the MD to which the maintenance end point (MEP) belongs is incorrectly configured.
The MDs and MAs respectively configured at the source and sink ends of the same service are inconsistent.
Certain physical links are incorrectly connected.
ETH_CFM_MISMERGE.impact: The CFM_OAM fails to test the service connectivity. The alarm does not affect services.

ETH_CFM_RDI.name: ETH_CFM_RDI
possible_causes: The opposite equipment detects a fault.
ETH_CFM_RDI.impact:
When the ETH_CFM_RDI alarm is generated, the services on the transmit side of the local
equipment may be interrupted.

ETH_CFM_UNEXPERI.name: ETH_CFM_UNEXPERI
possible_causes: The cycles of the continuity check (CC) of the MEPs at both ends are different.
The IDs of the MEPs at both ends conflict with each other.
Loopback occurs in the service, and loopback packets are received.
ETH_CFM_UNEXPERI.impact: The CFM_OAM fails to test the service connectivity. The alarm does not affect services.

ETH_EFM_DF.name: ETH_EFM_DF
possible_causes: Hardware equipment on the local end, such as the optical module, boards, or physical link, is faulty.
No OAM packet is received at the local end within a specified period.
The OAM settings of one end do not meet the requirements of the other end.

ETH_EFM_EVENT.name: ETH_EFM_EVENT
possible_causes: Boards at the two ends work improperly.
The physical link between the two ends is faulty.
ETH_EFM_EVENT.impact: Services degradation or even service interruption occurs.

ETH_EFM_LOOPBACK.name: ETH_EFM_LOOPBACK
possible_causes: The local port initiates a loopback request and the opposite port responds to the request.
The opposite port initiates a loopback request and the local port responds to the request.

ETH_EFM_REMFAULT.name: ETH_EFM_REMFAULT
possible_causes: The opposite port is faulty.
A board on the opposite NE works improperly.
The physical link between the two ends is faulty.
ETH_EFM_REMFAULT.impact: The opposite end is faulty and services at the port may be unavailable.

ETH_LINK_DOWN.name: ETH_LINK_DOWN
ETH_LINK_DOWN.impact:
When the ETH_LINK_DOWN alarm is generated during data transmission, the network port
negotiation fails. The data cannot be received and the services are interrupted.

ETH_LOS.name: ETH_LOS
possible_causes: The port is enabled, but no signal is received from the client side.

The working mode of the local port does not match the working mode of the opposite port. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 622
The port is enabled, but the network cable or fiber is connected incorrectly or faulty.
The opposite board is faulty.
The local board is faulty.
ETH_LOS.impact:
The network port fails to receive data and the services are interrupted.
l In the case of an electrical port, the bidirectional services are interrupted.
l In the case of an optical port, the services of certain working modes are interrupted.
– If the working mode is set to auto-negotiation, the bidirectional services are
interrupted.
– If the working mode is set to full duplex, the services in the receive direction are
interrupted.
Common Fault Symptom
NOTE
If this topic does not describe the common fault symptom or the actual fault symptom is not contained in
the description of the common fault symptom, handle the ETH_LOS alarm by following the steps
provided in Handling Procedure.
None.

ETH_MISCONNECT.name: ETH_MISCONNECT
possible_causes: When subracks are cascaded on a ring network, the ETH3 interface is connected to a subrack.

ETHOAM_DISCOVER_.name: ETHOAM_DISCOVER_
ETHOAM_DISCOVER_.description: FAIL The point-to-point Ethernet OAM discovery failure alarm

ETHOAM_RMT_CRIT_.name: ETHOAM_RMT_CRIT_
ETHOAM_RMT_CRIT_.description: FAULT A critical fault occurs to the remote end of point-to- point Ethernet OAM

ETHOAM_RMT_LOOP.name: ETHOAM_RMT_LOOP
ETHOAM_RMT_LOOP.description: The remote loopback of point-to-point Ethernet OAM alarm
ETHOAM_RMT_LOOP.impact:
The ETHOAM_RMT_LOOP alarm is generated when the system runs the IEEE 802.3ah
OAM protocol. When this alarm is generated, it indicates that the services are looped back
from the loopback initiation end to the loopback response end. The services and other packets
are all interrupted.

ETHOAM_RMT_SD.name: ETHOAM_RMT_SD
ETHOAM_RMT_SD.description: The remote SD of point-to- point Ethernet OAM alarm
ETHOAM_RMT_SD.impact:
The ETHOAM_RMT_SD alarm is generated when the system runs the IEEE 802.3ah OAM
protocol. IEEE 802.3ah OAM is a link management protocol and is irrelevant to services.
This alarm indicates that the error frame crosses the threshold at the receive end of the local
port and the service performance degrades.

ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP.name: ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP
ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP.description: Loopback of the MAC port that receives the OAM protocol packets in a point- to-point manner
ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP.impact:
In the case of the ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP alarm, the port is in the self-loop state. The U2000
provides a function of automatically shutting down the port in the case of the
ETHOAM_SELF_LOOP alarm. If the user enables this function in advance, services at this
port will be interrupted. Otherwise, a broadcast storm may occur.

ETHOAM_VCG_SELF_.name: ETHOAM_VCG_SELF_
ETHOAM_VCG_SELF_.description: LOOP Loopback of the VCTRUNK port that receives the OAM protocol packets in a point-to-point manner

EX_ETHOAM_CC_LOS.name: EX_ETHOAM_CC_LOS
EX_ETHOAM_CC_LOS.description: Loss of the periodic continuity check message
possible_causes: A software or hardware failure occurs in the services from the source maintenance point to the sink maintenance point.

Service congestion or service interruption occurs between the source maintenance point and the sink maintenance point. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 377
EX_ETHOAM_CC_LOS.impact: When this alarm occurs, a unidirectional continuity fault occurs on the source-sink link.

EX_ETHOAM_MPID_C.name: EX_ETHOAM_MPID_C
EX_ETHOAM_MPID_C.description: NFLCT The maintenance point ID conflict

EXT_MODULE_OFFLIN.name: EXT_MODULE_OFFLIN
EXT_MODULE_OFFLIN.description: E The extended wavelength module offline

EXT_SYNC_LOS.name: EXT_SYNC_LOS
EXT_SYNC_LOS.description: The loss of external clock source
possible_causes: The physical port for the external clock source loses signals.
The input and output modes of the external clock source are inconsistent.
The clock input cable is incorrectly connected.
The clock board is faulty.
EXT_SYNC_LOS.impact:
When the EXT_SYNC_LOS alarm is generated, the external clock source of the system is
lost and cannot be traced by the equipment. This is because the clock quality may be lowered,
the service quality may be affected, and pointer justifications and even bit errors may be
generated.

EXT_TIME_LOC.name: EXT_TIME_LOC
EXT_TIME_LOC.description: The loss of the external timing source
possible_causes: The physical port for the external time source loses signals.
The timing input cable is incorrectly connected.
The clock board is faulty.
EXT_TIME_LOC.impact:
The time of the local NE cannot be synchronous with the time of the external timing
equipment to which the enabled external timing port is connected.

FAN_FAIL.name: FAN_FAIL
FAN_FAIL.impact:
The failure of two or more fans leads to the increase of the board temperature and even the
damage to the board.

FAN_FAULT.name: FAN_FAULT
FAN_FAULT.impact:
The failure of one fan may lead to the increase of the board temperature and even the damage
to the board.

FC_8B10BERR_OVER.name: FC_8B10BERR_OVER
FC_8B10BERR_OVER.impact: The quality of services is affected.

FC_LINK_ERR.name: FC_LINK_ERR
possible_causes: The WDM side of the opposite OTU reports an R_LOS, R_LOF, OTUk_LOF, OTUk_LOM, or OTUk_AIS alarm. (The value of parameter 1 is 0x01.)

The ISL mode of the client equipment is incorrect or a mismatch of the flow control management mode occurs. (The value of parameter 2 is 0x01.) OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 379
The type or the time sequence of the services on the board is configured improperly.
The type of the client-side optical module on the board mismatches the type of the actual service, or the actual fiber mismatches the fiber type that the optical module supports.
The board is faulty (the value of parameter 2 is 0x03 or 0x04).
The client equipment is faulty (the value of parameter 2 is 0x02).

FC_SYNC_LOS.name: FC_SYNC_LOS
FC_SYNC_LOS.description: FC service synchronous word loss alarm
possible_causes: The rate of the services to be received mismatches the rate of the services that are actually received.
The transmit optical power is abnormal.

FCS_ERR.name: FCS_ERR
FCS_ERR.description: The frame check sequence (FCS) is incorrect
possible_causes: Mapping protocols of the local site and opposite site are inconsistent. For example, the local site uses the GFP encapsulation protocol whereas the opposite site uses the LAPS encapsulation protocol. Or the parameter settings of the protocol are inconsistent. For example, both sites use the GFP encapsulation but Extension Header Option of the local site is set to Yes whereas Extension Header Option of the opposite site is set to No.
There are bit errors on the link.
The optical connector of the Ethernet board at the optical port is loose or dirty.
The board is faulty.
FCS_ERR.impact:
l If the FCS_ERR alarm is generated due to inconsistent encapsulation protocols, the
services are interrupted.
l If the FCS_ERR alarm is generated due to bit errors in the system, packets are lost or
services are interrupted.

FC_AIS.name: FC_AIS
possible_causes: Client-side input signals contain an FC_AIS signal.
The peer board sends an FC_AIS signal.
FC_AIS.impact: The FC services carried on the optical port are interrupted.

FDBSIZEALM_ELAN.name: FDBSIZEALM_ELAN
FDBSIZEALM_ELAN.description: MAC address forwarding table of E-LAN used up
possible_causes: The value of Address Detection Upper Threshold is excessively small.

The E-LAN service is attacked. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 647
FDBSIZEALM_ELAN.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the E-LAN service stops learning new MAC addresses. As a result,
unknown unicast packets in the traffic flow may increase, and broadcast packets may increase
accordingly. In this case, the line rate may be affected.

FIBERTYPE_MIS.name: FIBERTYPE_MIS
FIBERTYPE_MIS.impact: The gain control may be inaccurate.

FLOW_OVER.name: FLOW_OVER
FLOW_OVER.description: The inflow at the Ethernet port exceeds the threshold
FLOW_OVER.impact:
l During data transmission, when the configured bandwidth is lower than the actual traffic
at the port and there is the FLOW_OVER alarm, service packets are lost.
l During data transmission, when the configured bandwidth is higher than or equal to the
actual traffic at the port and there is the FLOW_OVER alarm, the system and the
services are not affected.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
652

FEC_LOF.name: FEC_LOF
FEC_LOF.description: Received FEC is loss of frame
FEC_LOF.impact:
When the FEC_LOF alarm is generated, the FEC function is disabled. Consequently, the
services are interrupted.

FEC_OOF.name: FEC_OOF
FEC_OOF.description: Received FEC is out of frame
FEC_OOF.impact:
When the FEC_OOF alarm is generated, the FEC function becomes invalid. Consequently,
services are interrupted.

FOP_NR.name: FOP_NR
FOP_NR.description: Protection group does not receive the negotiation response from the peer end
possible_causes: No protection group is configured at the peer end or the protection type and configuration at the peer end are inconsistent with those at the local end.
Dual-ended protection switching is not enabled for the peer end.

Services on the protection channel are interrupted. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 653

FOP_PM.name: FOP_PM
FOP_PM.description: Inconsistency between the transmitted B bit in the protection protocol and the received B bit
FOP_PM.impact:
Working channels at both ends are inconsistent after services on the working channels are
restored.

FOP_PR.name: FOP_PR
FOP_PR.description: Inconsistency between the transmitted R bit in the protection protocol and the received R bit
FOP_PR.impact:
Working channels at both ends are inconsistent after services on the working channels are
restored.

FPGA_ABN.name: FPGA_ABN
FPGA_ABN.impact:
The active FPGA file of the board is abnormal and the standby FPGA file is enabled. If the
standby FGPA file is abnormal, the board cannot work, which will affect services. This
problem needs to be handled in time.

FSELECT_STG.name: FSELECT_STG
FSELECT_STG.description: The clock board is forcibly selected
FSELECT_STG.impact:
If the forcibly selected clock board runs properly, services will be interrupted transiently
during the switchover. If the board is faulty, services will be interrupted.

FWD_PKT_LOSS.name: FWD_PKT_LOSS
FWD_PKT_LOSS.impact:
The services lose packets or are interrupted.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
657

GAINDATA_MIS.name: GAINDATA_MIS
possible_causes: As for the nominal gain, replacing an optical amplifier (OA) board or the optical module causes that the nominal gain value issued by the NE software falls beyond the new gain adjustment range.
GAINDATA_MIS.impact:
The service quality may be affected.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
658

GFP_UPM.name: GFP_UPM
GFP_UPM.impact:
After a board receives a packet indicating UPI mismatch, the board chip marks the packet as
an incorrect packet and discards it in the traffic control module, which will interrupt services.

HARD_BAD.name: HARD_BAD
possible_causes: The NE power supplies are abnormal.
The board is not connected to the backplane properly or the board is faulty.
HARD_BAD.impact: The alarm affects the normal operating of the board and affects services.

HARD_ERR.name: HARD_ERR
HARD_ERR.impact: The alarm has no impact on services. For other impact, see Parameter.

HARD_NONSUPPORT.name: HARD_NONSUPPORT
HARD_NONSUPPORT.description: Hardware does not support the configuration delivered by the SCC board
HARD_NONSUPPORT.impact:
When this alarm is reported, the configuration cannot take effect. Specifically, when this
alarm is reported during service configuration, the service fails to be applied to the hardware
and therefore cannot be deployed. If this alarm is reported when IEEE 1588 is enabled, the
IEEE 1588 function will fail to be enabled.

HP_LOM.name: HP_LOM
HP_LOM.description: Loss of multiframe in the higher order path
possible_causes: The service level is inconsistent between the source and sink ends.
The cross-connect and clock board is faulty. As a result, the H4 byte is lost or incorrect.
HP_LOM.impact: The alarm will interrupt path-level services.

HP_RDI.name: HP_RDI
HP_RDI.description: A remote defect in the higher order path
HP_RDI.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the local end is not affected. This alarm only indicates that the
remote path-level services are interrupted.

HP_REI.name: HP_REI
HP_REI.description: A remote error indication in the higher order path
HP_REI.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the local NE is not affected. This alarm indicates only that the higher
order services generate error bits when traversing NEs and deteriorates.

HP_SLM.name: HP_SLM
HP_SLM.description: A signal label mismatch alarm in the higher order path
possible_causes: On the local NE, the received C2 byte (signal label overhead in the HP), which is not 0x00, is inconsistent with the to-be-received C2 byte.
The service type is incorrectly configured.
The board on the terminating NE works improperly.
HP_SLM.impact:
If the AU-AIS alarm is inserted when the HP_SLM alarm occurs, the path services are
interrupted. In addition, the HP_RDI alarm is transmitted to the peer NE.

HP_TIM.name: HP_TIM
HP_TIM.description: A trace identifier mismatch alarm in the higher order path
HP_TIM.impact:
If the AU-AIS alarm is inserted when the HP_TIM alarm occurs, the path services are
interrupted. In addition, the HP_RDI alarm is transmitted to the peer NE.

HP_UNEQ.name: HP_UNEQ
HP_UNEQ.description: An alarm indicating that no signals are loaded in the higher order path
HP_UNEQ.impact:
If the AU-AIS alarm is inserted when the HP_UNEQ alarm occurs, the path services are
interrupted. In addition, the HP_RDI alarm is transmitted to the peer NE.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
674

IGSP_ENTRIES_EXC.name: IGSP_ENTRIES_EXC
IGSP_ENTRIES_EXC.description: The number of IGMP Snooping multicast table entries exceeds its upper threshold
possible_causes: The configured upper threshold for the number of IGMP Snooping multicast table entries is too small.
IGMP Snooping protocol attack packets are generated on the network.
IGSP_ENTRIES_EXC.impact:
After the IGSP_ENTRIES_EXC alarm is reported, the IGMP Snooping multicast table has no
more space for learning new table entries. As a result, some IGMP service packets will be
discarded.

IN_PWR_ABN.name: IN_PWR_ABN
possible_causes: The threshold of the optical power is not set properly.
The fiber connector is loose or dirty.
The model of the selected optical module is incorrect.
The board at the local end is faulty.
The board at the opposite end is faulty.
IN_PWR_ABN.impact:
The IN_PWR_ABN alarm affects service transmission performance and may result in service
interruption.
Common Fault Symptom
NOTE
If the possible causes do not correspond to any symptoms, or the symptoms are not listed in this topic,
handle the alarm according to the handling procedures.
None.

IN_PWR_HIGH.name: IN_PWR_HIGH
IN_PWR_HIGH.description: Input optical power is too high
possible_causes: The optical power threshold is not set properly.
The transmit optical power is high at the peer end.
The alarm-reporting board is faulty.
IN_PWR_HIGH.impact:
When this alarm occurs, bit errors occur in the services on the optical port. In addition, high
receive optical power will damage the laser.

IN_PWR_LOW.name: IN_PWR_LOW
IN_PWR_LOW.description: Input optical power is excessively low
possible_causes: The optical power threshold is not set properly.
The fiber connector is loose or contaminated.
The transmit optical power is low at the peer end.
The alarm-reporting board is faulty.
IN_PWR_LOW.impact:
When this alarm occurs, plenty of bit errors occur in the received signals, which affects
service receiving.

INNER_COMMUN_MISCO.name: INNER_COMMUN_MISCO
INNER_COMMUN_MISCO.description: N Connection between an internal network and an external network

INSUFFCNT_FLSH_SPACE.name: INSUFFCNT_FLSH_SPACE
INSUFFCNT_FLSH_SPACE.impact: The flash file storage space is insufficient. As a result, file storage in the flash fails.

INSUFFCNT_MEM_SPACE.name: INSUFFCNT_MEM_SPACE
INSUFFCNT_MEM_SPACE.impact:
The space of the memory file system is insufficient. Package loading may fail and database
backup may fail.

INSERTION_LOSS_HIGH.name: INSERTION_LOSS_HIGH
INSERTION_LOSS_HIGH.description: Excessive insertion loss between the TDC and RDC optical ports
INSERTION_LOSS_HIGH.impact:
The gain adjustment of the optical amplifier board fails, which results in a command issuing
failure.

INTRA_OTU_PS.name: INTRA_OTU_PS
possible_causes: A user delivers an external switching command such as forced switching or manual switching. Such a command makes the active channel of the intra-board 1+1 protection group switch from the working channel to the protection channel. Therefore, the alarm is reported.
The services on the working channel of the intra-board 1+1 protection group are faulty. The active channel automatically switches to the protection channel and the alarm is reported.
INTRA_OTU_PS.impact:
When an intra-board 1+1 protection group undergoes protection switching, services are
transiently interrupted. When this alarm is reported, the working channel of the intra-board
1+1 protection group might have faulty services that needs to be restored.

INTRA_OTU_STA_INDI.name: INTRA_OTU_STA_INDI
INTRA_OTU_STA_INDI.description: The state of the intra-board 1+1 optical channel protection group
possible_causes: A user delivers a command to perform the external switching such as forced switching, manual switching, or lockout switching.
The services of the working or protection channel of the intra-board 1+1 protection group are faulty.
The switching is in WTR state. After the time specified by WTR Times elapses, the alarm clears.
INTRA_OTU_STA_INDI.impact:
l When the intra-board 1+1 protection group undergoes switching, services are transiently
interrupted.
l When the alarm is reported, the working or protection channel of the board might have
faulty services that need to be restored.

IPA_FAULT.name: IPA_FAULT
IPA_FAULT.impact:
If all detection boards of IPA are offline, IPA will fail.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
687

IPA_SHUT.name: IPA_SHUT
IPA_SHUT.impact:
The laser on the corresponding output port of the board is shut down and therefore cannot
launch optical power to the downstream board.

J0_MM.name: J0_MM
J0_MM.description: J0 byte or trace indicator mismatch

K1_K2_M.name: K1_K2_M
K1_K2_M.description: The K1 and K2 bytes mismatch alarm
K1_K2_M.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the multiplex section protection (MSP) is unavailable. If a fiber cut
or another fault occurs, services may be interrupted.

K2_M.name: K2_M
K2_M.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the MSP is unavailable. If a fiber cut or another fault occurs, services
may be interrupted.

L_SYNC.name: L_SYNC
L_SYNC.impact:
When loss of synchronization occurs in the PCS of a receiving port, the port stops receiving
data. Therefore, this alarm affects service quality. In this case, services are interrupted.

LAG_DOWN.name: LAG_DOWN
possible_causes: No LAG is configured for the opposite NE.
All member ports in the LAG are unavailable.

LAG_MEMBER_DOWN.name: LAG_MEMBER_DOWN
possible_causes: The port is unavailable or is disabled.
The port receives no LACP packet.
The port works in half-duplex mode.
The port is self-looped.
LAG_MEMBER_DOWN.impact:
The impact on the system varies depending on the load-sharing mode used.
l In load-sharing mode, packet loss may occur continuously due to bandwidth
insufficiency.
l In load non-sharing mode, link switching is triggered and packet loss occurs temporarily.

LAG_PORT_FAIL.name: LAG_PORT_FAIL
LAG_PORT_FAIL.description: Aggregation group VCG port failure alarm
LAG_PORT_FAIL.impact:
The port in the aggregation group fails to share the service load. In this case, the port cannot
receive or transmit services.

LAG_VC_PORT_FAIL.name: LAG_VC_PORT_FAIL
LAG_VC_PORT_FAIL.description: Aggregation group VCG port failure alarm
LAG_VC_PORT_FAIL.impact:
The port in the aggregation group fails to share the service load. In this case, the port cannot
receive or transmit services.

LAN_LOC.name: LAN_LOC
LAN_LOC.impact:
The communication at this network port fails and some NEs may be unreachable by the
U2000, but the services on the NEs are not affected.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
699

LASER_OPEN_FAIL.name: LASER_OPEN_FAIL
LASER_OPEN_FAIL.impact: Services may fail to be provisioned.

LASER_HAZARD_WARNI.name: LASER_HAZARD_WARNI
LASER_HAZARD_WARNI.description: NG Warning indication of the laser hazard level.

LASER_MOD_ERR.name: LASER_MOD_ERR
LASER_MOD_ERR.description: Wrong type of optical module inserted
LASER_MOD_ERR.impact:
When the installed optical module is incorrect, the performance of the optical port is
degraded. In severe cases, the services are interrupted.

LASER_SHUT.name: LASER_SHUT
LASER_SHUT.description: The laser of the board is shut down
possible_causes: For OCS system boards, the user uses the U2000 to shut down the laser.
For a non-coherent 40G board in a WDM system, the laser is shut down because the board temperature exceeds the permitted range.
LASER_SHUT.impact: When the LASER_SHUT alarm is generated, services are interrupted.

LASER_PARA_ERR.name: LASER_PARA_ERR
LASER_PARA_ERR.impact:
An error occurs during optical module parameter verification, but communication and
services are not affected.

LASER_TYPE_MISMATCH.name: LASER_TYPE_MISMATCH
possible_causes: The optical port type supported by the physical board does not match the type of the optical module inserted into the optical port.
LASER_TYPE_MISMATCH.impact: Services will be interrupted or the laser on the optical module is not on.

LSR_KEY_UNLOCK.name: LSR_KEY_UNLOCK
possible_causes: The cover of the interlock switch on the TN97ERPC board panel is opened.
The interlock switch on the front panel of another board rather than TN97ERPC is not properly tightened.
LSR_KEY_UNLOCK.impact:
If the alarm is reported on the TN97ERPC board, the optical module is powered off, the board
laser is turned off, and the services are interrupted. If the alarm is reported on another board,
services are not affected.

LCAS_FOPR.name: LCAS_FOPR
LCAS_FOPR.description: The failure of the LCAS protocol in the receive direction
LCAS_FOPR.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the protocol state machine in the receive direction is confused, which
may result in improper negotiation.

LCAS_FOPT.name: LCAS_FOPT
LCAS_FOPT.description: The failure of the LCAS protocol in the transmit direction
LCAS_FOPT.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the protocol state machine in the transmit direction is confused,
which may result in improper negotiation.

LCAS_PLCR.name: LCAS_PLCR
LCAS_PLCR.description: Partial loss of capacity in the LCAS receive direction
LCAS_PLCR.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the available bandwidth in the receive direction decreases, but
services still keep running.

LCAS_PLCT.name: LCAS_PLCT
LCAS_PLCT.description: Partial loss of capacity in the LCAS transmit direction
LCAS_PLCT.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the available bandwidth in the transmit direction decreases. This
results in packet loss when the actual outgoing traffic exceeds the available bandwidth.

LCAS_TLCR.name: LCAS_TLCR
LCAS_TLCR.description: The total loss of capacity in the LCAS receive direction
LCAS_TLCR.impact:
When this alarm occurs, no bandwidth is available in the receive direction. That is, services
are interrupted in this direction.

LCAS_TLCT.name: LCAS_TLCT
LCAS_TLCT.description: Total loss of capacity in the LCAS transmit direction
LCAS_TLCT.impact:
When this alarm occurs, there is no available bandwidth in the transmit direction. That is,
services are interrupted in this direction.

LCS_DAYS_OF_GRACE.name: LCS_DAYS_OF_GRACE
LCS_DAYS_OF_GRACE.impact:
When the license has expired but is still within the keepalive period of 60 days, the system
functions are not affected, but this alarm is reported every day, reminding the user of updating
the license.

LCS_EXPIRED.name: LCS_EXPIRED
LCS_EXPIRED.impact:
When the license has expired and the keepalive period of 60 days has also elapsed, only the
default functions of the system are available.

LCS_FILE_NOT_EXIST.name: LCS_FILE_NOT_EXIST
LCS_FILE_NOT_EXIST.impact: If no license file is loaded, only the default functions of the system are available.

LCS_SHORTAGE_SHELF.name: LCS_SHORTAGE_SHELF
LCS_SHORTAGE_SHELF.impact: The function limited by license becomes unavailable.

LINK_ERR.name: LINK_ERR
possible_causes: The transmit and receive ports work in different modes.
Ethernet boards at both ends have different optical modules, or the types of the two optical modules do not match those of the fibers connected to them.
The fibers or cables connected to the Ethernet ports fail.
The board is faulty.
The service type of the client equipment mismatches the service type of the interconnected OTU.
The settings of the auto-negotiation mode of the two interconnected Ethernet ports are inconsistent. For example, one port is in auto-negotiation mode but the other is in non-negotiation mode.
The input optical power of the two interconnected Ethernet ports is excessively high or low.
The fiber or cable that connects the two Ethernet ports fails.
The optical module types of the two interconnected Ethernet boards are inconsistent. Therefore, the types of fibers that the two optical modules can be connected to are inconsistent.
The data equipment on the client side is faulty.
The board that reports this alarm is faulty.
LINK_ERR.impact:
When the alarm occurs during data transmission, the network port negotiation fails. The
services cannot be received and thus the services are interrupted.

LOCAL_FAULT.name: LOCAL_FAULT
LOCAL_FAULT.impact: If the board receives the LOCAL_FAULT alarm, the received services may be interrupted.

LOCKPOW_MIS.name: LOCKPOW_MIS
LOCKPOW_MIS.impact: The service quality may be affected.

LOCK_CUR_FAIL.name: LOCK_CUR_FAIL
LOCK_CUR_FAIL.impact:
The output optical power of the board will fail to be locked, which affects the services on the
entire optical line.

LOOP_ALM.name: LOOP_ALM
possible_causes: A loopback command is issued for the test or maintenance purpose. OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 403
The loopback command is delivered during testing or maintenance.
LOOP_ALM.impact: When this alarm occurs, services are interrupted.

LP_RDI_VC3.name: LP_RDI_VC3
LP_RDI_VC3.description: Aremote defect indication in the VC-3 lower order path
LP_RDI_VC3.impact:
This alarm does not affect the local services, but indicates that services fail to be received by
the peer end.

LP_SLM_VC3.name: LP_SLM_VC3
LP_SLM_VC3.description: A signal label mismatch alarm in the VC-3 lower order path
LP_SLM_VC3.impact: When this alarm occurs, the system is not affected.

LP_UNEQ_VC3.name: LP_UNEQ_VC3

When the MS_REI alarm is generated, the number of B2 bit errors received at the opposite
station is beyond the specified range. The services at the local station are not affected, but the
service quality at the opposite station is degraded.

have faulty services that need to be restored.

interrupted.

may have faulty services that need to be restored.

the services may be interrupted.

redundancy of the system decreases, which affects the subsequent capacity expansion.

TDC and RDC optical ports on an OAU board), the input optical power of the
downstream signals and the redundancy of the system decrease. The services may have
bit errors or even be interrupted.

When the ODUk SP protection group actuates switching, services are transiently interrupted.
When this alarm is reported, the working channel of the ODUk SP protection group might
have faulty services that need to be restored.

interrupted.

protection group may contain faulty services. In this case, you need to remove the fault
to restore the services.

OH_LOOP.name: OH_LOOP
OH_LOOP.impact:

not affected but ECC communications are interrupted.

OMS_PWR_ADJ_FAIL.name: OMS_PWR_ADJ_FAIL
OMS_PWR_ADJ_FAIL.impact:
The line attenuation is excessively large and cannot be compensated by adjusting the intra-NE
attenuation or gain. In this case, the service signals may be unstable and the BER may
increase.

ONE_PUMP_WORK.name: ONE_PUMP_WORK
ONE_PUMP_WORK.impact:
When only one pump card is working, there is no impact on the system operation, and no
service interruption occurs. There is, however, a risk. When the current working card fails,
services quality are impacted because there is no backup card.

OOL.name: OOL
OOL.description: The phase-locked loop is out of lock
OOL.impact:
When the OOL alarm is generated, the phase-locked loop cannot lock on the input signals,
and as a result the output clock signals are affected. This alarm may degrade the quality of
services or interrupt the services.

OOS_LOST.name: OOS_LOST
OOS_LOST.impact:
Services are not affected when this alarm is caused by incorrect fiber connections. If this
alarm is due to other causes, optical-layer overheads are affected.

OPA_FAIL_INDI.name: OPA_FAIL_INDI
OPA_FAIL_INDI.description: Automatic adjustment of power during optical cross-connection failed
possible_causes: The optical power budget is insufficient.
The attenuation of the configured V A1 or V A4 board is manually modified.

When there are adjustment points of multiplexed wavelengths and each single wavelength in OPA scenarios, the attenuation of the VOAs at the multiplexed wavelength adjustment points is not adjusted to the minimum value. For example, in the OPA application scenario, the built-in VOAs on multiplexer or demultiplexer boards or optical add/drop multiplexer (OADM) boards adjust single wavelengths, and the V A1 or V A4 boards on the line side or the built-in VOAs adjust multiplexed wavelengths.
OPA_FAIL_INDI.impact:
l When the alarm is reported, the attenuation of the board is not adjusted. For new
services, the services may be unavailable. For existing services, the QoS cannot be
improved.
l This alarm indicates an operation failure instead of a fault being detected. In other words,
this alarm persists even after you manually adjust the attenuation and services are
restored.

ORP_CRITICAL_HI.name: ORP_CRITICAL_HI
ORP_CRITICAL_HI.impact:
The fiber connections are abnormal. If the reflection optical power is increasing, the laser may
be automatically turned off, causing service interruption.

OSC_CLK_MISMATCH.name: OSC_CLK_MISMATCH
OSC_CLK_MISMATCH.impact:
The alarm impact on services varies depending on the alarm handling method:
l If the system does not require the IEEE 1588 clock function, replacing the OSC board
(TN11AST2) has no impact on services.
l If the system needs to enable the IEEE 1588 clock function, the system control and
cross-connect board or clock board needs to be replaced, which has impact on services.

OSC_BDI.name: OSC_BDI
OSC_BDI.impact: The OSC signals carried by the optical port will fail.

OSC_DEG.name: OSC_DEG
OSC_DEG.impact:
If the alarm is generated, the OSC signals carried by the optical port will generate bit errors,
which makes the OSC signals fail or even be unavailable.

OSC_LOS.name: OSC_LOS
possible_causes: An optical port on the board that reports the alarm is not connected to a fiber.
The laser of the board at the opposite station is shut down.
The attenuation of the transmission line is excessively high, or a fiber cut occurs on the transmission line.
The transmit part of the opposite station is faulty.
The receive part of the local station is faulty.
OSC_LOS.impact: There is a fiber cut in the receive direction and this can cause loss of the monitoring signals.

OSC_RDI.name: OSC_RDI
OSC_RDI.impact: The communication between the two sites is abnormal.

OTU_AIS.name: OTU_AIS
OTU_AIS.impact:
When this alarm occurs, the entire ODU channel is disconnected. As a result, services are
unavailable.

OTU_LOF.name: OTU_LOF
OTU_LOF.impact: When this alarm occurs, the FEC function fails, and services are interrupted.

OTU_LOM.name: OTU_LOM
OTU_LOM.impact:
If the alarm is generated, the signal quality of the services at the optical port is degraded. The
service signals may be unavailable.

On an ASON network, a service board at the peer site does not carry services and an OA board emits white light (without signal frames).

OTS_TIM.name: OTS_TIM
OTS_TIM.description: Trail trace identifier mismatch at OTS layer
OTS_TIM.impact:
Services are not affected if this alarm is caused by incorrect TTI configurations and are
interrupted if this alarm is caused by incorrect fiber connections.

OUT_PWR_HIGH.name: OUT_PWR_HIGH
OUT_PWR_HIGH.description: Output optical power is too high
possible_causes: The optical module of the laser is faulty or the board is faulty.
OUT_PWR_HIGH.impact:
l When the output optical power is excessively high, the input optical power at the receive
end will be very high if no proper optical attenuator is used at the receive end. As a
result, the module at the receive end may be damaged.
l If the board works abnormally, the existing services are affected.

OUT_PWR_ABN.name: OUT_PWR_ABN
OUT_PWR_ABN.impact:
When the OUT_PWR_ABN alarm occurs, the service transmission performance is affected
and even the services are interrupted.

OUT_PWR_LOW.name: OUT_PWR_LOW
OUT_PWR_LOW.description: Output optical power is excessively low
OUT_PWR_LOW.impact:
The output optical power of the laser is excessively low, which influences the normal
transmission of services.

OWSP_PS.name: OWSP_PS
possible_causes: A user issues an external switching command such as forced switching or manual switching. Such a command makes the current channel of the OWSP protection group switch to the protection channel from the working channel. The alarm is reported.
The services of the working channel of the OWSP protection group are faulty. The current channel automatically switches to the working channel and the alarm is reported.
OWSP_PS.impact:
When the OWSP protection group undergoes switching, services are transiently interrupted.
When this alarm is reported, the working channel of the OWSP protection group might have a
service fault that needs to be restored.

OWSP_STA_INDI.name: OWSP_STA_INDI
OWSP_STA_INDI.description: the state of the optical wave share protection group
OWSP_STA_INDI.impact:
l When the OWSP protection group performs switching, services are transiently
interrupted.
l When this alarm is reported, the working or protection channel of the OWSP protection
group may have a service fault that needs to be restored.

PASSWORD_NEED_CHAN.name: PASSWORD_NEED_CHAN
PASSWORD_NEED_CHAN.description: GE Default password must be changed

PATCH_ACT_TIMEOUT.name: PATCH_ACT_TIMEOUT
PATCH_ACT_TIMEOUT.impact:
The activation of the patch is not in the stable state. If the board is reset in this case, the patch
does not take effect after the system restarts, and the patch is automatically restored to the
deactivated state. The functions of the patch are not available or the bug corrected by the
patch appears again.

PATCH_DEACT_TIMEOUT.name: PATCH_DEACT_TIMEOUT
PATCH_DEACT_TIMEOUT.impact:
The deactivated state indicates that the patch is loaded but the patch is not running. If the
board is reset in this case, the patch is automatically restored to the idle state after the system
restarts. The functions of the patch are not available or the bug corrected by the patch appears
again.

PATCH_PKGERR.name: PATCH_PKGERR
PATCH_PKGERR.impact: Package loading management of some boards may be unavailable if this alarm is generated.

PID_AUTO_ADJUST_FAIL.name: PID_AUTO_ADJUST_FAIL
PID_AUTO_ADJUST_FAIL.description: Automatic adjustment failure of PID optical power alarm
PID_AUTO_ADJUST_FAIL.impact:
The optical power of the PID board does not meet requirements, which may cause instable
service signals and BER increases.

PRO_PKT_FLOODING.name: PRO_PKT_FLOODING
PRO_PKT_FLOODING.description: Protocol packet flooding attacks detected alarm.
PRO_PKT_FLOODING.impact:
l A lot of CPU resources will be occupied, causing system instability.
l Normal protocol packets may be lost, causing the protocol jitter.

PM_BDI.name: PM_BDI
PM_BDI.description: ODU PM section backward defect indication
PM_BDI.impact:
This alarm is generated only on the ODU termination NE for services in the transmit
direction, which does not affect services in the receive direction.

PM_BEI.name: PM_BEI
PM_BEI.description: ODU PM section backward error indication
PM_BEI.impact:
When this alarm occurs, PM_BIP check bit errors occur on the ODU termination NE, which
does not affect the FEC function or performance on the local NE.

PM_BIP8_OVER.name: PM_BIP8_OVER
PM_BIP8_OVER.description: ODU layer, PM section BIP exceed the upper threshold
PM_BIP8_OVER.impact: When this alarm occurs, service transmission quality is affected.

PM_BIP8_SD.name: PM_BIP8_SD
PM_BIP8_SD.description: Optical channel data unit layer, path monitoring section bit interleaved parity signal degraded
PM_BIP8_SD.impact:
When this alarm occurs, service transmission quality is affected.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 4 Clearing Alarms
892

PM_TIM.name: PM_TIM
PM_TIM.description: ODU layer PM section TTI mismatch
PM_TIM.impact: When this alarm occurs, the FEC function and services are not affected.

PORT_EXC_TRAFFIC.name: PORT_EXC_TRAFFIC
PORT_EXC_TRAFFIC.description: Traffic at Ethernet ports over the threshold
possible_causes: The configured value is small for the bandwidth threshold on the Ethernet port.
The configured Ethernet port traffic is heavy.
PORT_EXC_TRAFFIC.impact: When this alarm occurs, overlarge traffic will cause network congestion.

PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE.name: PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE
possible_causes: The optical module does not exist or is not correctly inserted.
The optical module or the board is faulty.
PORT_MODULE_OFFLINE.impact:
Absence of the optical module leads to an interruption of services carried at the corresponding
optical port.

PORTSWITCH_FAIL.name: PORTSWITCH_FAIL
PORTSWITCH_FAIL.impact:
When the MCA board reports this alarm, the spectrum analysis data at optical ports cannot be
queried.

PORT_WLLCFG_REPEATE.name: PORT_WLLCFG_REPEATE
PORT_WLLCFG_REPEATE.description: D Repeated wavelength locking configurations are found on the optical ports of an OTU board

POWER_ABNORMAL.name: POWER_ABNORMAL
possible_causes: The input power of the PIU is abnormal.
The jumper cap of the SCC is not configured.
The power module on the board is faulty.
POWER_ABNORMAL.impact:
When the POWER_ABNORMAL alarm is generated, the power supply functions abnormally,
and the board may not be able to function normally.

POWER_DIFF_OVER.name: POWER_DIFF_OVER
POWER_DIFF_OVER.description: Power difference between active and standby channels crossed the threshold
POWER_DIFF_OVER.impact:
The switching of the active and standby channels is affected. As a result, the quality of the
received services is affected.

POWER_SAMPLE_DIFF.name: POWER_SAMPLE_DIFF
POWER_SAMPLE_DIFF.description: The current power and sampling power are inconsistent
POWER_SAMPLE_DIFF.impact:
This alarm does not affect the current services, but it needs to be cleared in a timely manner;
otherwise, services may be interrupted when protection switching occurs.

POWER_FAIL.name: POWER_FAIL
possible_causes: If this alarm is reported by the system control board, the battery of the system control and communication board is abnormal (the value of parameter 1 of this alarm is 0x05). OptiX OSN 8800/6800/3800 Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms Issue 01 (2017-03-31) Huawei Proprietary and Confidential Copyright © Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. 450
If this alarm is reported by the PIU board, the input voltage of the subrack is abnormal because the power supply module is faulty (the value of parameter 1 of this alarm is 0x3d or 0x3f).
If this alarm is reported by the PIU or CRPC board, the power supply module of the board fails or is aging (the value of parameter 1 of this alarm may be any value except 0x05).
POWER_FAIL.impact:
l When this alarm is reported by the system control board, the system time and the NE
configuration data of the latest 30 minutes will be lost when the power supply fails.
l When this alarm is reported by other boards,
– If the active power supply fails but the standby power supply is normal, there is no
impact on the existing services because the switching to the standby power supply
is performed.
– If both active and standby power supplies fail, the existing services are interrupted.

PRBS_LSS.name: PRBS_LSS
possible_causes: The link is abnormal. Therefore, the board, on which the PRBS bit error test is performed, does not receive the PRBS signals from the local board.
The board is faulty or the line is degraded.
PRBS_LSS.impact: The PRBS test services on the board are interrupted.

PTP_SOURCE_SWITCH.name: PTP_SOURCE_SWITCH
possible_causes: The physical link is faulty.
Quality level, priority 1, or priority 2 of the Grandmaster clock changes.
The network topology changes.
PTP_SOURCE_SWITCH.impact:
After this alarm is generated, the IEEE 1588v2 tracing source is switched. As a result, the
entire clock domain undergoes a switchover.

PTP_TIMESTAMP_ABN.name: PTP_TIMESTAMP_ABN
possible_causes: The delay mode settings for the ports on two interconnected boards are inconsistent.
The hardware of the IEEE 1588v2 port currently traced is faulty.
The hardware of the clock board is faulty.
The clock module at the transmit end of the reference source is faulty.
PTP_TIMESTAMP_ABN.impact:
A time stamp abnormality during PTP frequency synchronization results in a clock trace
abnormality, clock drift, PTP time trace abnormality, and time deviation.

PUM_TEM_ALM.name: PUM_TEM_ALM
PUM_TEM_ALM.description: Working temperature of the pump laser over threshold
PUM_TEM_ALM.impact:
The pump laser may be aged. Reporting of this alarm has no impact on the services. If no
measure is taken to handle the alarm after a period of time, however, the output optical power
of the board or even the services are affected.

PUM_BCM_ALM.name: PUM_BCM_ALM
PUM_BCM_ALM.description: Working current of pump laser over threshold
PUM_BCM_ALM.impact:
The pump laser may be aged. Reporting of this alarm has no impact on the services. If no
measure is taken to handle the alarm after a period of time, however, the output optical power
of the board or even the services are affected.

PUMP_COOL_EXC.name: PUMP_COOL_EXC
PUMP_COOL_EXC.description: Cooling current of pump laser over threshold
possible_causes: The ambient temperature of the board is excessively high or low.
The pump laser temperature is excessively high or low.
The board that reports this alarm is faulty.
PUMP_COOL_EXC.impact:
When this alarm is reported, the laser ages sharply and the performance of output signals
deteriorates.

PUMP_LINK_ULLAGE_HI.name: PUMP_LINK_ULLAGE_HI
PUMP_LINK_ULLAGE_HI.description: GH Pump laser connection insertion loss alarm

PUMP_MIS_MATCH.name: PUMP_MIS_MATCH
PUMP_MIS_MATCH.impact:
l When the type of only one card mismatches the board type, Only one pump card can
work, the board is unable to provide the protection function for the pump card. There is,
however, no impact on services.
l When the types of the two cards mismatch the board type, the board cannot work
normally. Services are interrupted.

the alarm indicating excessively low or high path optical power may occur and the
performance may be abnormal.

R_LOC.name: R_LOC
R_LOC.description: Loss of clock on receiving line
R_LOC.impact: When this alarm occurs, services on the line port are interrupted.

R_LOF.name: R_LOF
R_LOF.description: Loss of frame on receiving line
possible_causes: Two boards at different rates are interconnected.
The transmit cable is faulty, and the fiber connector is loose or contaminated.
The local receive board is faulty so that the frame structure is lost.
The peer transmit or cross-connect board is faulty so that the frame structure is lost.
R_LOF.impact:
l When this alarm occurs, services are interrupted, and the local NE inserts an AIS signal
to the downstream NE.
l When this alarm occurs, the system automatically returns an MS_RDI signal to the
upstream NE. Then, the upstream NE reports the MS_RDI alarm.

R_LOS.name: R_LOS
R_LOS.description: Loss of signal on receiving line
possible_causes: The local optical port is unused.
The peer laser is disabled so that no optical signal is input.
The fiber is cut or the line performance deteriorates.
The local receive board is faulty so that signals fail to be received.
The peer transmit board or cross-connect board is faulty so that signals fail to be transmitted.
R_LOS.impact:
When this alarm occurs, either of the following will interrupt services on the receive side of
the line:
l The system automatically inserts an AIS signal to the downstream NE.
Alarms and Performance Events Reference 3 Clearing Common Alarms
460
l The system automatically sends an MS_RDI signal to the upstream NE so that the
upstream NE reports the MS_RDI alarm.
If a data board reports an R_LOS alarm, the Ethernet port enters the link-down state.
If an E-Line service is configured between the Ethernet port and the corresponding
VCTRUNK port, the VCTRUNK port may insert a management frame containing the client
signal fail (CSF) signal to the downstream NE.

R_OOF.name: R_OOF
R_OOF.description: Out of frame on receiving line
R_OOF.impact: Services carried at the optical port where this alarm is generated are interrupted.

R_SLIP.name: R_SLIP
possible_causes: The clock configuration is wrong or the clock signals are not synchronous.
The optical line attenuation is excessively high or the receive optical power is excessively high.
The fibers at the eastward and westward optical ports on the OSC board are connected reversely.
The board that reports this alarm is faulty.
R_SLIP.impact:
This alarm affects the services carried by the OSC board. For example, the optical supervisory
signals or clock signals are degraded. As a result, the NE is disconnected from the U2000
system.

precision of the system decreases.

SPAN_LOSS_HIGH.impact:

increase. As a result, the alarm indicating excessively low path optical power may occur and
the performance may be abnormal.

the channel is excessively high may be generated and the performance may be abnormal.

VCTRUNK ports. As a result, services on the VCTRUNK ports are interrupted. Make the
number of timeslots consistent between the source and sink before you proceed.

SPEED_OVER.name: SPEED_OVER
SPEED_OVER.description: Data rate exceeding the set limits

one. The board cannot carry the service and the service is interrupted.

SRV_SHUTDOWN_LD.impact: When this alarm occurs, services are interrupted.

system reset.

SUBNET_RT_CONFLICT.name: SUBNET_RT_CONFLICT

SUBRACK_EXCEED.description: Number of slave subracks exceeding threshold

system control board, switching failure, and upgrade failure may be present, and no slave
subrack can be added.

subracks is protected.

SUBRACK_ID_CONFLICT.name: SUBRACK_ID_CONFLICT

SUBRACK_ID_CONFLICT.impact:
The communication between the subracks is out of order; the command cannot be issued to
the corresponding subrack and the boards become unreachable by the NMS. When a subrack
ID conflict occurs on an NE, the board configurations may be incorrect, a communication
abnormality may occur, and even worse protection switching and service running may be
affected.

SUBRACK_LOOP.name: SUBRACK_LOOP
SUBRACK_LOOP.impact:
A network storm occurs during inter-subrack communication, which may make inter-subrack
communication unavailable.

SUM_INPWR_HI.name: SUM_INPWR_HI
SUM_INPWR_HI.description: Sum input optical power is too high

services have bit errors or are even interrupted.

SUM_INPWR_LOW.name: SUM_INPWR_LOW

services in use may have bit errors or even are interrupted.

SW_SNCP_PS.name: SW_SNCP_PS

encounter service failures and needs to be restored.

SW_SNCP_STA_INDI.name: SW_SNCP_STA_INDI
SW_SNCP_STA_INDI.description: The state of the Sub- Wavelength SNCP protection group.

may encounter service failures and needs to be restored.

Free space of the board is insufficient.

saved into the database and will be lost upon a power failure.

manual switching state. This alarm does not affect services.
